name: Al-Hutay'a
bio: Jarwal ibn Aws of Abs wrote before and after the coming of Islam. Known as al-Hutay'a, he satirised even himself. His praise could also sting, as the rival patrons in his poem for the house of Shammas discovered. Al-Zirikli relates that Umar imprisoned him at Medina after al-Zibriqan complained, then released him after a plea in verse. He died around 45 AH (665 CE).
